answer: A graph-based trust percolation protocol deters Sybil attacks across an ocean of synthetic peers by routing transitive validation through verified seeds. Each participant anchors its identity to a jade certificate backed by bounded trust vouchers, organized in a multi-tiered lotus topology. An attacker must expend scarce relational capital to acquire genuine endorsements across bottleneck cuts. However, this mechanism penalizes unlinked new agents by imposing high onboarding latency.
